role: local governments supporting Grange Avenue upgrade proposal
stance_basis: paraphrase states support contingent on FHWA approval of interstate access and ramp facilities
summary: Local governmental units supported the Corridor #1 proposal to upgrade Grange Avenue to a four-lane divided highway for improved airport access, but only on the condition that the Federal Highway Administration would approve the right of access to the interstate system and ramp facilities to Grange Avenue. Their support was thus conditional rather than unconditional.
complaint_summary: Local governmental units supported the Corridor #1 four-lane divided highway proposal for improved airport access, provided that FHWA would approve interstate access rights and ramp facilities to Grange Avenue.
summary_quote: The proposal of a four lane divided highway, for improved access to the airport, had the support of local governmental units provided the right of access to the interstate system and ramp facilities to Grange Avenue would be approved by the Federal Highway Administration.
